sql:
SELECT 
    CASE 
        WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > SUM(CASE WHEN p.publisher_name = 'DC Comics' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) THEN 'Marvel Comics'
        ELSE 'DC Comics'
    END as leading_publisher,
    ABS(
        SUM(CASE WHEN p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) - 
        SUM(CASE WHEN p.publisher_name = 'DC Comics' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
    ) as difference
FROM superhero s
JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id
